title: Allow any admin (not just owner) to grant admin access

requirements.text: Update backend admin-access authorization so any caller who is an admin can grant admin access to another user (by email), instead of restricting this action to only the owner.

quotes: make it so any admin can give admin access not just owner

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the backend method that grants admin access (used by the frontend as actor.grantAdminAccess(email)) succeeds when invoked by any authenticated admin caller.
The same method traps/returns an authorization error when invoked by a non-admin caller.
A successful grant operation writes an audit log entry identifying the acting admin principal and the target email.
No migration is required (existing admin email/principal mappings continue to work after upgrade).

requirements.text: Update backend admin-access authorization so any caller who is an admin can revoke admin access (by email), instead of restricting this action to only the owner.

quotes: make it so any admin can give admin access not just owner

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the backend method that revokes admin access (used by the frontend as actor.revokeAdminAccess(email)) succeeds when invoked by any authenticated admin caller.
The same method traps/returns an authorization error when invoked by a non-admin caller.
A successful revoke operation writes an audit log entry identifying the acting admin principal and the target email.
The owner email (traviscastonguay@gmail.com) remains protected from being revoked if the UI/logic currently enforces that behavior.

requirements.text: Update the Admin Access Management UI copy so it no longer claims the feature is owner-only, and reflects that any admin can grant/revoke admin access.

quotes: make it so any admin can give admin access not just owner

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAccessSection.tsx, the description text "Owner-only: Grant or revoke admin access" is changed to English wording that indicates admins can grant/revoke admin access.

No functionality regressions in the Admin Access section: listing admin emails, granting access, and revoking access still use the existing hooks (useListAdminEmails/useGrantAdminAccess/useRevokeAdminAccess).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth option).
Do not redesign the admin panel beyond the minimal copy/behavior changes required for admin delegation.
Do not change how the initial owner/admin bootstrap is configured during deployment (caffeineAdminToken / existing bootstrap flow).
